Package com.hkust.marketplace.ui

Class ChatText

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.ui.ChatText
public final class ChatText extends Object
The wording of the shared chat screens (ChatView, ChatList), kept apart from the JavaFX code so it can be unit-tested.

    • respondButton

      public static String respondButton(int waiting)
      The seller's button while the chat has open offers: "Respond in Offers & Requests (2)". It is a link: the seller answers offers only on Offers & Requests (Task 2.5).

    • choiceHeading

      public static String choiceHeading(Conversation conversation, int counters)
      The heading of the Agree to Counter dialog: whose counters, and the listing. "Agree to a counter from Sam Lee" with "'Calculus Textbook', newest first" under it; the order is mentioned only when there is more than one counter.
